name: cao_su_phu_rieng
query:
SELECT 
  last("value_cm1") AS "r_freq_cm1",
  last("value_cm2") AS "r_freq_cm2"
FROM (
  SELECT 
    "value" AS "value_cm1" 
  FROM "caosu_measurement" 
  WHERE "mapping_tag"::tag = 'r_freq_cm1' 
    AND time >= 1787677200000ms AND time <= 1787763599999ms
), (
  SELECT 
    "value" AS "value_cm2" 
  FROM "caosu_measurement" 
  WHERE "mapping_tag"::tag = 'r_freq_cm2' 
    AND time >= 1787677200000ms AND time <= 1787763599999ms
)
GROUP BY time(1m) 
FILL(none)
